enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping, with the fan running on low to stay cool during the warm night
enriched_activities.desc: Lie on bed. Eyes closed. Breathe in. Breathe out. Turn to left side. Bend knees. Pull blanket. Adjust pillow. Move arm. Turn to right side. Stretch legs. Fan running. Remain asleep. Snore. Turn head. Remain asleep.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face and brushing teeth, taking a cool shower before the hot day
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Wash face. Brush teeth. Turn on shower. Adjust water temperature. Step into shower. Wash body. Turn off shower. Dry body. Put on clothes.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating breakfast, boiling the kettle for tea and toasting bread
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into kitchen. Turn on light. Open fridge. Take out bread. Place bread in toaster. Turn on toaster. Fill kettle with water. Place kettle on base. Turn on kettle. Open cupboard. Take out mug. Take out tea bag. Put tea bag in mug. Pour hot water into mug. Stir tea. Take toast out of toaster. Put toast on plate. Sit at table. Eat breakfast. Drink tea.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed in light work clothes and checking the phone for shift updates and the heatwave warning
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out clothes. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Check shift updates. Read heatwave warning. Put phone in pocket.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the health care facility in the morning heat
enriched_activities.desc: Walk out of house. Lock door. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Get off bus. Walk to facility. Enter facility.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional, attending to patients and clinical duties
enriched_activities.desc: Enter facility. Walk to locker room. Change into scrubs. Walk to nurse station. Pick up clipboard. Read patient list. Walk to patient room 1. Knock on door. Enter room. Greet patient. Check blood pressure. Check temperature. Administer medication. Record notes. Walk to next patient.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a lunch break and eating a packed meal in the staff area
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to staff area. Sit at table. Open lunch bag. Take out container. Open container. Pick up fork. Eat food. Wipe mouth. Close container. Put container back in bag. Stand up. Walk back to work area.

enriched_activities.activity: Continuing clinical work and patient care on the afternoon shift
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to patient room. Knock on door. Enter room. Greet patient. Check vital signs. Administer medication. Update patient chart. Consult with doctor. Answer phone. Attend to patient call. Walk to supply room. Restock supplies. Walk to nurse station. Enter notes into computer. Prepare for shift handover.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting home after the shift in the peak afternoon heat
enriched_activities.desc: Leave facility. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Get off bus. Walk home. Unlock door. Enter house.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a cool shower and changing into light home clothes
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on shower. Adjust water temperature. Step into shower. Wash body. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Grab towel. Dry body. Put on home clothes.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking and eating dinner, using the induction cooker and microwave
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into kitchen. Turn on light. Open fridge. Take out ingredients. Place ingredients on counter. Turn on induction cooker. Place pan on cooker. Add oil. Add ingredients. Stir food. Turn on microwave. Heat food in microwave. Take out plate. Serve food. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing dishes and loading the dishwasher, packing lunch for the next shift
enriched_activities.desc: Clear table. Scrape plates. Load dishwasher. Add detergent. Close dishwasher. Turn on dishwasher. Open fridge. Take out container. Take out food. Put food in container. Close container. Put container in fridge.

enriched_activities.activity: Watching TV and using the computer to relax, relying on the fan instead of the air conditioner during the evening peak tax period
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into living room. Turn on light. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channels. Pick up laptop. Open laptop. Turn on laptop. Browse internet. Watch TV. Adjust fan. Turn off TV. Close laptop. Turn off light. Walk out of living room.

enriched_activities.activity: Night washing routine, brushing teeth and getting ready for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Wet toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wash face. Dry face. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading and browsing the phone in bed with the desk lamp on and the fan running
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into bedroom. Turn on desk lamp. Pick up book. Open book. Read pages. Turn page. Put down book. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Browse social media. Scroll. Type message. Put down phone. Turn off desk lamp. Lie down. Close eyes.

enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping, keeping the fan on and delaying air conditioner use until the peak tax period ends
enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe in. Breathe out. Turn to left side. Bend knees. Pull blanket. Adjust pillow. Move arm. Turn to right side. Stretch legs. Fan running. Remain asleep. Snore. Turn head.
